page_title: LUT 2-3 CHE | Luton v Chelsea 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Cauley Woodrow (Luton) replaces Albert Sambi Lokonga.
90+4' The expression of the referee Paul Tierney is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is shown a yellow card.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Cole Palmer is replaced by Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Tahith Chong (Luton) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
87' Today's referee Paul Tierney rightly decides to book Axel Disasi (Chelsea) for his harsh tackle.
87' 2 - 3 Goal! Elijah Adebayo (Luton) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:3.
86' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.

84' Carlton Morris (Luton) climbs highest near the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick. He steers a header towards the roof of the net, but Djordje Petrovic punches the ball away, deflecting it onto the crossbar.
84' It seemed like Alfie Doughty (Luton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
84' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Luton.
84' Alfie Doughty (Luton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
83' Wow, what an escape. Ross Barkley (Luton) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
82' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) is caught offside!
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) coming on for Noni Madueke.

80' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Ross Barkley (Luton) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the left post. 1:3.
79' Alfie Doughty (Luton) will take the corner.
79' An attempted cross from Alfie Doughty (Luton) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
79' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!

78' Ross Barkley (Luton) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Djordje Petrovic pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
77' Teden Mengi (Luton) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
77' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
75' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Luton players look gutted.
75' The Luton players halt their celebrations as referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
74' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) leaps to meet a beautiful cross and pings a header past the goalkeeper low into the middle of the net.
70' 0 - 3 Cole Palmer (Chelsea) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
67' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
67' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

67' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
66' Tahith Chong (Luton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Elijah Adebayo.

65' Teden Mengi (Luton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
62' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Andros Townsend is replaced by Carlton Morris (Luton).
62' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Armando Broja.
60' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
57' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and signals a foul after Elijah Adebayo (Luton) brought his opponent down.
57' Flag goes up against Alfie Doughty (Luton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
54' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick, but Djordje Petrovic reads it well and stops the effort.
54' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Luton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
53' Tahith Chong (Luton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Luton force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Andros Townsend (Luton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paul Tierney signals. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
51' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
50' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
50' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
48' Djordje Petrovic leaps to intercept the corner kick from Alfie Doughty (Luton).

48' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
47' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and Paul Tierney blows for a foul. Luton have a free kick.
46' Rob Edwards has made a change at the break. Tahith Chong has come on in place of Issa Kabore (Luton).
46' Half-time substitution. Jacob Brown (Luton) will not participate anymore and Chiedozie Ogbene is coming on.
46' Referee Paul Tierney blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
45+3' Ross Barkley (Luton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Flag up against Andros Townsend (Luton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' Ross Barkley (Luton) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
45' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Levi Colwill (Chelsea) commits a foul after dangerous play. Luton will take a free kick.
44' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
43' Jacob Brown (Luton) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out for a corner. Luton can continue in their attacking effort.
43' Alfie Doughty (Luton) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
42' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Ross Barkley (Luton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Luton.
42' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Luton.
41' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Armando Broja (Chelsea) is flagged for offside.
40' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
39' Issa Kabore (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for an infringement. Chelsea win a free kick.

37' 0 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Noni Madueke (Chelsea) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top right corner and makes it 0:2. Thomas Kaminski was helpless.
35' The free kick from Ross Barkley (Luton) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
34' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Paul Tierney stops the game and makes a call. Luton win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
32' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
32' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Djordje Petrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
30' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' The ball is cleared after Jacob Brown (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Luton.
29' Andros Townsend (Luton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
27' Jacob Brown (Luton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
27' Dangerous play by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Luton, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
25' The free kick is taken by Alfie Doughty (Luton), but ball is cleared.

25' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Luton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
24' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after Gabriel Osho (Luton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Chelsea earn a free kick.
24' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
23' Armando Broja (Chelsea) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
22' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
21' Armando Broja (Chelsea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Issa Kabore (Luton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
20' Paul Tierney has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ross Barkley (Luton).
19' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Ross Barkley (Luton), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
18' It seems like Ross Barkley (Luton) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
18' Referee Paul Tierney sees the trip by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Luton earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
15' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:1.
12' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
11' The linesman signals that Issa Kabore (Luton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

11' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
8' Ross Barkley (Luton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

6' Thomas Kaminski was forced into action to thwart Conor Gallagher (Chelsea). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
3' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Alfie Doughty (Luton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
2' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Noni Madueke (Chelsea) and blew his whistle. Luton are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will referee today's match.
